summary: Private foundation university in Ankara with 23 undergraduate programmes taught entirely in English across five faculties. IB Diploma minimum is 29 points.
about: International applicants apply online with an exam or diploma result and school documents. Engineering, architecture, economics and business have extra SAT maths limits, but no IB subject rule is published.

handoff.label: How to apply as an international student

ib.text: IB Diploma: minimum total 29/45. A 29 average also exempts you from the English preparatory year. No subject rule or Course Results route is published.

languageOfInstruction.note: TED University's FAQ states teaching is 100% English in all undergraduate programmes. Students without English proof start in the English Language School.

admissionRoutes.text: TEDU lists an IB Diploma with a minimum total of 29 out of 45 as an accepted qualification. No subject, HL or predicted-grade rule is published.
Only the full IB Diploma is listed; no Course Results route is published. Ask the International Programs Office before relying on certificates.

notes: Documents to apply: passport, diploma or graduation certificate (with expected graduation date and score), official transcript, official exam or diploma result, photo, and a funder letter if you have financial support. Registration also needs apostilled documents and a Turkish high-school equivalency certificate.

No application deadline for 2027 entry was found on the undergraduate pages. The academic calendar showed tuition payment and registration for admitted international undergraduates from 1 July to 25 September 2026. Confirm 2027 dates with TEDU.

English proof (equivalencies page): TEDU EPE 60 from September 2026; TOEFL iBT 4 (Writing 4) on the new scale, or 79 with Writing 20 before 21 Jan 2026; PTE Academic 55; CAE or CPE grade C. Home Edition and MyBest TOEFL are not accepted.

Tuition per year, VAT included: USD 11,800 for Architecture and Design, Arts and Sciences, Economics and Administrative Sciences and Engineering; USD 7,500 for Education. The fee page is undated, so confirm the 2027-28 price and any scholarship.
Dual citizens and Turkish citizens who studied in Turkey or TRNC generally cannot apply on this route; read the application provisions page.
